title: The Ark Among the Philistines

questions.question: Where did the Philistines take the ark first?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:1 (ESV): “When the Philistines captured the ark of God, they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.”

questions.question: What happened to Dagon’s statue?
options: It fell face down and broke
questions.correctAnswer: It fell face down and broke
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:3-4 (ESV): “...behold, Dagon had fallen face downward... and the head of Dagon and both his hands were lying cut off...”

questions.question: What affliction struck the people of Ashdod?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:6 (ESV): “The hand of the Lord was heavy against the people of Ashdod... and afflicted them with tumors...”

questions.question: Where did the Philistines send the ark after Ashdod?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:8 (ESV): “...‘Let the ark of the God of Israel be brought around to Gath.’...”

questions.question: What did the people of Ekron demand?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:11 (ESV): “...‘Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it return to its own place...’”

questions.question: Where was Dagon's temple located?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:2 (ESV): "Then the Philistines took the ark of God and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it up beside Dagon." (Context implies Ashdod from verse 1).

questions.question: What happened the second morning to Dagon?
options: Head and hands were cut off on the threshold
questions.correctAnswer: Head and hands were cut off on the threshold
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:4 (ESV): "...the head of Dagon and both his hands were lying cut off on the threshold..."

questions.question: What custom arose regarding the threshold of Dagon?
options: Priests do not tread on the threshold
questions.correctAnswer: Priests do not tread on the threshold
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:5 (ESV): "This is why the priests of Dagon... do not tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day."

questions.question: What happened when the ark came to Gath?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:9 (ESV): "...the hand of the LORD was against the city, causing a very great panic, and he afflicted the men of the city... so that tumors broke out on them."

questions.question: Where was the ark sent after Gath?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:10 (ESV): "So they sent the ark of God to Ekron."

questions.question: What phrase described the atmosphere in the city of Ekron?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:11 (ESV): "For there was a deathly panic throughout the whole city. The hand of God was very heavy there."

questions.question: Who gathered to decide what to do with the ark?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:8 (ESV): "So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines..."

questions.question: Only the ______ of Dagon was left to him.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:4 (ESV): "...Only the trunk of Dagon was left to him."

questions.question: What did the men who did not die suffer from?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:12 (ESV): "The men who did not die were struck with tumors..."

questions.question: The cry of the city went up to ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:12 (ESV): "...and the cry of the city went up to heaven."

key_verse_text: But when they rose early on the next morning, behold, Dagon had fallen face downward on the ground before the ark of the LORD... (ESV)
